title: Think Beyond Your Current Self
description: When making future plans: - Pause: Ask, "Will future me feel the same way?" - Imagine different scenarios: Consider how changes in mood, priorities, or environment might affect your choices. - Build flexibility: Leave room to adapt as your preferences evolve. Example: Booking a gym membership? Think about whether your motivation will match your current enthusiasm in a month.
